sources.title: Business Finland: Cash rebate (AV production incentive)
sources.said: The production incentive in Finland is a maximum of 25% cash rebate for production costs. ... The budget for the audiovisual production incentive for 2026 is 10 million euros. ... AV-production incentive is available for Feature films Documentary films Serial fiction Animation productions However, please note: The AV production incentive cannot be granted to commercials or promotional products, document series, non-scripted series e.g. reality shows or talk shows ... Eligible costs incurred in Finland can be a maximum of 80% of the total production budget ... At least 25 % of funding for the overall production budget must come from outside Finland ... A distribution agreement for at least one platform or one territory.

sources.title: Business Finland: minimum requirements table (image on the cash-rebate page, under 'Minimum requirements for funding in 2026'), read from the image
sources.said: TOTAL BUDGET OF PRODUCTION MINIMUM ... EXPENDITURE IN FINLAND ... TV DRAMA AND ANIMATION 11 500 € / minute 500 000 €

sources.title: Finnish Film Foundation: Production support guide
sources.said: The production support is aimed at the production of films based on an artistic plan. The film may be a feature-length or short fiction, documentary, animation or children's film, documentary or animated series, or a combination thereof. ... • development support for drama series (episodes 22 minutes and over) ... • production support: documentary films and series, short films, animated series ... development and production support cannot be granted to a television or streaming company

sources.title: Government Decree 1203/2023 on the payment of compensation for audiovisual productions for 2024–2026 (Business Finland's English translation)
sources.said: An agreement that guarantees distribution must be drawn up for any production eligible for cash rebate.

figures.finding: The flat rate also covers travel and royalties, so it caps the fee and overheads only from above. The Foundation's 5% overheads cap (held) is for its films.
